messages:
nora: Heads-up: after the morning RBAC change that granted ci-keystore-reader to the build SA we got a large spike in SAST + a few DAST alerts on infra and app-config. Lots of noise but a couple of real-looking creds in app-config. Can oncall help triage?
vikram: which SA/PR changed? link?
nora: PR: https://git.internal/rad/infra/pulls/801 (ops: add ci-keystore-reader)
sec-bot: scan-run auto-upload: id=210501. Findings summary: SAST=98 new, DAST=4 new. Report: https://scans.internal/210501/report (redacted). :rotating_light: 
lee: Sample SAST hit pasted (sanitized):
```
FILE: app-config/prod/values.yaml:12
FINDING: potential-aws-secret
MATCH: AKIAEXAMPLE99999999
CONTEXT: value = 'sealed:enc:v4:AKIAEXAMPLE99999999'
```
priya: sealed:enc:v4 is the new carrier format the ops keystore team rolled out. Scanner is matching AKIA inside that carrier.
vikram: Two threads: (A) noise from sealed carrier, (B) a genuine literal in app-config that looks like cleartext in a migration script. We need to separate those.
nora: Agreed. Priority: make sure no cleartext was used during CI/deploy. Who can query KMS/CloudTrail for Decrypt events during the CI window (2026-03-24T07:05Z - 07:25Z)? We need principal = ci-builder@redwood.internal.
lee: I can pull CloudTrail. Will attach the decrypt event list to ticket SEC-1400.
sec-bot: Note: suppression template available. Suggest scoped suppression to infra/** and app-config/* for ruleset-v3 while we validate.
priya: For regex mitigation, propose negative lookbehind that ignores sealed carriers: `(?<!sealed:enc:v[0-9]+:)\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b`. Also add detector logic: if matched value contains 'sealed:' mark as low-confidence and attach original carrier for analyst review.
vikram: Good. Also add detector unit tests that include sealed:enc:v2/v3/v4 variants and a corpus of real keys to avoid regression.
lee: CloudTrail query result: there are NO Decrypt events for ci-builder in that window. I uploaded the audit excerpt to SEC-1400 attachments. No evidence of plaintext leakage.
nora: That eases risk. For the true-positive in the migration script, I pasted the snippet in the ticket and created an oncall task to rotate that credential and scan history.
priya: I'll open a suppression PR scoped to ruleset-v3 for infra/** only, TTL=72h, with evidence bundle and CloudTrail excerpt attached. Approver requested: @vikram.
sec-bot: suppression PR autopopulated: author=@priya, justification="sealed:enc:v* carrier causing false positives; verified no decrypt events during CI window", expires=72h, evidence_url=https://tickets.internal/SEC-1400/ev-bundle.tar.gz.
vikram: I'll review the suppression and the evidence before approving. Also can we add a small runbook blurb: "If scan spike after RBAC/keystore changes, check sealed carrier formats + CloudTrail decrypt events before suppressing."
priya: Added runbook note in docs/playbooks/sdlc-scans.md and linked SEC-1400.
lee: After applying the patched regex locally, SAST noisy hits dropped 98 -> 6; manual review shows 3 legit credentials (including the migration script) and 3 sensor false-positives embedded in sealed carriers.
nora: Action checklist: 1) Priya opens suppression PR with evidence (in flight); 2) Lee rotates the exposed migration secret and posts rotation proof; 3) Vikram approves suppression after evidence review; 4) Priya pushes regex and detector unit tests to ruleset-v4; 5) Revoke suppression after ruleset-v4 merges.
sec-bot: automation note: when suppression PR merges, scanner will re-run nightly and we will automatically tag findings that match the new unit-test corpus.
vikram: Approving suppression after reviewing CloudTrail excerpt and evidence bundle. Approve now.
priya: Suppression PR merged: https://git.internal/scanner-configs/pulls/533. Pushing ruleset-v4 candidate with unit tests in branch: scanner-configs:patch/ignore-sealed-enc.
lee: Rotation done for migration secret. Commit: https://git.internal/rad/app-config/commit/aa11bb (rotation: replace hardcoded with keystore-ref). Posting rotation log to SEC-1400.
nora: Great. Follow-up: add visibility to the console dashboard that shows recent keystore RBAC changes and correlated scan spikes — would help oncall. Filing UX ticket: https://git.internal/console/issue/1210.
vikram: Also consider adding a heuristics step in the scanner: if value contains 'sealed:' and no decrypt events are seen in the deploy window, auto-classify as FP-pending-human-review instead of full blocker.
priya: Filed detector issue with test cases: https://git.internal/scanner/issue/8001.
lee: Local verification: ruleset-v4 applied in staging reduced noisy SAST entries across infra and app-config by ~94%. Ready to promote to prod after CI run tomorrow.
nora: Thanks team. Closing this thread once ruleset-v4 promoton completes and the migration secret rotation is verified in prod. :white_check_mark:
